mapRules: Each student/question contributes its latest attempt. Each response uses its latest suggestion and teacher correction. Minimum: one response. Uncertainty means M06/FOLLOW_UP, or an uncorrected suggestion below 0.75, marked for follow-up, or missing a supporting quote. Reviewed means a saved correction.

mapJourneyHelp: Saved events for this student and topic, in time order (IST). Responses form a history; support links to its assignment and reassessment. A later score does not show that support caused a change.
mapJourneyGaps: Only saved events appear. Missing support or reassessment means that part of the journey is not recorded.
mapJourneyEmpty: No saved events yet. Start an assessment.

guideIntro: Find your next step, manage display preferences, and get help.
guideStep1: Inspect the original response and supporting quote on the map. Confidence is not accuracy.
guideStep2: Choose a supported correction, give a reason and confirm. The original AI suggestion remains visible.
guideStep3: Review the group members, approve the proposal, then explicitly confirm support for the group.
guideStep4: Students practise, finish the activity and complete a reassessment. Inspect saved results without assuming a causal learning effect.
guideDataText: Class membership, student codes, answers, teacher feedback and activity results are saved to support classroom learning. When AI is enabled, question and response content may be processed by the configured AI service.
guideDeviceText: Downloaded lessons and offline practice are stored on this device. Synchronize your practice in Learning Lab before signing out. Browser data cleanup can remove unsynchronized work.
guideLanguage: Interface translations are available in English, Hindi and Telugu. Independent educator language review has not been recorded. Original student text is shown unchanged.
guideStatusHelp: Manual checks only. Provider configuration does not prove network reachability or generation quality. No AI request is made by this check.
guideSupportText: Contact your school or the person who shared ClassPulse with you. Include the page and what you were trying to do. Do not share passwords or student answers. This page sends no support report.
